candidates.statement: The space E = HomC(V, W) is related to the classiﬁcation of instantons (cf. Equation (1.1) Chapter III of [1]).

Up to an automorphism of Aev, there exists a unique involutive sub- algebra AF ⊂Aev of maximal dimension admitting oﬀ-diagonal Dirac operators. It is given by (4.2) AF = {(λ ⊕q, λ ⊕m) | λ ∈C , q ∈H , m ∈M3(C)} ⊂H ⊕H ⊕M4(C) , using a ﬁeld morphism C →H. The involutive algebra AF is isomorphic to C ⊕H ⊕ M3(C) and together with its representation in (H, J, γ) it gives the noncommutative geometry F of [7].
